name: FedEx Freight Hub - West Jefferson OH (Columbus, CMH)
type: Freight LTL hub service center (~278 doors)

fieldNotes.facility: Confirmed FedEx Freight CMH service center at 10 Commerce Pkwy via the long LTL cross-dock building footprint and the FedEx Freight monument sign visible at the entrance driveway in Street View (pano captured 2024-08). Geocoded point landed on the building.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Single controlled truck entrance off Commerce Pkwy on the SE side. A fence line crosses the entrance driveway at a pinch point - clearly visible on z20/z21 satellite.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small square guard-booth structure (~1-2 parking-space footprint) sits beside the truck driveway at the gate pinch point - clearly resolved on z21 satellite.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long LTL cross-dock building with dock doors and trailers backed in along the entire length of BOTH long faces. ~278 doors per FedEx Freight service-center data; 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large trailer drop yards on the SE side and beyond the NW dock end; hundreds of parked trailers. dropYard true, 50+ band.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The entrance driveway from Commerce Pkwy to the gate is long and can stack multiple trucks; deep approach.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved apron and yard around the gate; room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Paved apron outside the gate along the entrance driveway provides truck waiting space.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town site near West Jefferson OH in a small industrial area surrounded by farmland and retention ponds; Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main long LTL cross-dock building plus a separate shop/maintenance building on the SE; 2 buildings.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single combined entry/exit driveway through the gate; lane split not crisply resolved.

citations.claim: FedEx Freight service center CMH at 10 Commerce Pkwy, West Jefferson OH; Priority+Economy dual hub

verification.rationale: FedEx Freight (LTL) CMH dual-hub (1 of 12); FedEx Freight spun off June 2026 as FDXF but still operates this terminal; no closure.
